svg.text: Court occupancy - PPA Indoor Nationals mixed final, 2026-01-25
Each panel is one player’s own half, net at the top. Ends are folded and the far end mirrored, so left/right is the player’s own.
COURT FRAME — where they actually stood
The physical half of the court, ends folded. A player who rotates through both service halves reads double-humped here; that is real, not an artefact.
RALLY-RELATIVE — controlled for which half they lined up in
Each rally mirrored so the half the player STARTED in is always left of the dotted line. Right of it is the half the partner started in.
Men vs men and women vs women only: a men-vs-women map would show a ROLE difference in mixed, not a player difference.
349 player-rallies mapped · 4 dropped from the relative frame (start half unreadable)
Position density measures SPACE, never intent.
